mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in GDP growth over two consecutive quarters indicates weakening aggregate demand, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate lower corporate earnings.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative GDP growth signal.
